Mock bundle topology setup and teardown helpers for bundle tile tests.

# Purpose
This file defines test support code for the bundle tile and its gRPC and TCP connection state. It builds a mock bundle environment in [`test_bundle_env_create`](<#test_bundle_env_create>), where it allocates and joins an `fd_mcache` and `fd_dcache`, sets up a fake `fd_stem_context_t`, creates a `fd_bundle_tile_t` state object, and initializes the gRPC client and keepalive logic. The code also sets default socket and timing state so tests can run without a real network peer.

The helper functions then force specific connection states for tests. [`test_bundle_env_mock_conn_empty`](<#test_bundle_env_mock_conn_empty>) creates a local socket pair and sets the tile into a connected state with keepalive timestamps. Other helpers mark the HTTP/2 handshake as done, make builder info available, and create active gRPC streams for bundle and packet subscriptions. [`test_bundle_env_mock_conn`](<#test_bundle_env_mock_conn>) combines these steps and checks the resulting bundle client status. [`test_bundle_env_destroy`](<#test_bundle_env_destroy>) releases sockets and workspace allocations and clears the test environment.
